overview_description.description: Transportr is a digital logistics marketplace brought to life after a detailed assessment of the shippers’ pains in the logistics and freight sectors. We offer a seamless digital process from request and tracking to invoicing, we are committed to using  technology and data analytics to unlock the supply and demand dynamics within the entire supply chain. Our mission is to improve your logistics experience and business.

product.description: Allows shippers to book shipments immediately with real-time pricing.

product.name: Tracking & Visibility
product.description: Provides shippers with the ability to track shipments and gain visibility into the logistics process.

product.name: Land Logistics
product.description: A service that connects trucks, trailers, and drivers in a fragmented market through a digital platform.
